# Research brief (seed, hermetic)

Topic: How swing bowling changes as the ball gets older in a Test match
Niche: OTHER / custom — "cricket analysis" (user-entered idea, see fixture.json)
Language: English | Target: ~60 seconds

Key points to cover (original seed notes, not copied text):
- A new ball has a proud seam and a shiny side, so it can swing early.
- As overs pass, one side roughens; conventional swing fades and, in the
  right conditions, reverse swing can appear with an older ball.
- Captains time bowling changes around these phases — that tactical choice
  is the analysis angle for casual fans.
